title: Seek Wisdom
coreMove: Borrowed judgment steadies the mind when you let tested counsel question your first impulse, choose teachers with care, and turn a good line into the next clear act.

exampleSpecs.audience: a leader before the inbox takes over
exampleSpecs.stakes: the first reply of the day may carry yesterday's pride
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small observed object lets Socrates become a practical first question.

exampleSpecs.audience: an administrator repairing a failed rule
exampleSpecs.stakes: a wise line was admired but not enacted
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The failure is already over, and the misstep is treating Confucius as decoration.

exampleSpecs.audience: a facilitator who notices ego in real time
exampleSpecs.stakes: the session can become performance instead of inquiry
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The center is the moment Monique notices her own quote collecting.

exampleSpecs.audience: a director turning reading into policy
exampleSpecs.stakes: an old idea must become a concrete front-desk act
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The written artifact carries the scene and turns Confucius into a test.

exampleSpecs.audience: two coordinators choosing what will guide volunteers
exampleSpecs.stakes: the same pressure can produce quote theater or changed conduct
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Diya and Sylvie face the same intake problem with opposite approaches and different outcomes.

exampleSpecs.audience: a leader stuck in reading without action
exampleSpecs.stakes: books can become avoidance unless they clarify the next duty
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A peer gives one quotable reframe that turns reading back into conduct.
